packageRules.description: Pinned at v1.14.0: newer 1.14.x releases send empty x-amz-tagging to B2

ARC refuses to run a controller and a scale set on different chart versions, so the two must land in one PR. Not automerged: these are 0.x, where a minor bump has broken the runner API before, and merging here changes the live cluster.

Databases and indexes that migrate their on-disk format on a version bump, and cannot be rolled back afterwards. Meilisearch v1.53.2 was automerged on 2026-09-13 and crashlooped karakeep's index until it was pinned back. A MariaDB series bump needs mariadb-upgrade, and a PostGIS bump needs ALTER EXTENSION. Renovate proposes these; a human runs them.
